slice: P4 selected AC1018 compound LAYER source providers
scope: Private source-only lookup of the original group-8 layer names of the selected same-import AC1018 INSERT/ATTRIB/SEQEND compound. It returns each unique original LAYER provider handle under a specified printable ASCII case-fold policy.

contract.operation: Require the authenticated prior source relation, one TABLES section and LAYER table, complete selected-table record census and source spans, unique canonical table/self identities and owners, expected subclass and outer group-2 name. Refuse unknown selected-table rows, foreign-scope LAYER records, invalid names, collisions or missing providers; publish no handles on failure.
contract.resource: Use separate conservative halves of the work and retained-byte limits for the prior relation and new census. Require one repeated self admission only for this observed raw-plus-typed capture route.
contract.unqualified: Native collation, layer semantics, BLOCK target and XDICTIONARY, graph, output or general support.

validation.focusedControls: Generated ASCII/binary: selected-name duplicates, case variants and invalid names; missing or duplicate tables and provider handles; wrong owner and foreign scope; missing, duplicate and wrong-scope group 8; context substitution; work/byte boundaries and corrected fresh-data retries. These are route-level no-provider controls, not proof that each reaches the final census. Unknown selected-table row handling uses a synthetic owner-consistent census, not an accepted physical unknown-row witness.
validation.chronology: Final normal and ASan tests ran the shared frozen code; actual original and derivative probes were refreshed against the rebuilt shared normal adapter and library.

independentPeer.derivation: Locally change the unrelated LAYER group-2 name Layer2 to layer1.
independentPeer.observations: Independent pre-setup physical projection finds INSERT 704 and SEQEND 706 on Layer1 and ATTRIB 705 on 0, with 21 original LAYER records. Layer1 resolves to 275, 0 to 10, both owned by TABLE 2. The derivative has two ASCII-folded Layer1 matches. The actual shared-linked probe resolves only the original while prior source relation, block-name and APPID checks remain true for both.

limitations: ASCII matching is an explicitly selected policy, not native name collation. Non-ASCII, control-character and backslash names refuse.
No layer flags, rendering semantics, live graph or output are qualified.
Neither the independent sample nor its local derivative is committed.
